say:7:1560302004:0.text: Wow! Cedartown is livelier than last time.

say:9:1560302005:0.text: Of course it is. Winter Carnival always brings a little sparkle to the mountains. Now come in, all of you.
say:9:1560302005:0.source_cn: 那是当然，毕竟隆冬节可是一年一度的大节日啊！

say:10:1560302006:1.text: Traveling in this cold must've frozen your bones! I made a hot meal—sit down, eat, and warm those fingers before they fall off.

say:13:1560302007:0.text: This is incredible! Thank you so much, Madam Gerda.
say:13:1560302007:0.source_cn: 呀！这……这太丰盛了！谢谢你，格尔达女士。

say:16:1560302010:1.text: Poor man's barely had a moment to breathe, but things are settling nicely.
say:16:1560302010:1.source_cn: 这几个月来，他解决了不少难题，基本稳定下来了公国的秩序。

say:17:1560302011:1.source_cn: 雪松镇没有受到什么影响吧？

say:18:1560302012:1.text: Not even a sneeze, dear. In fact, we've had more guests than ever. My hot springs barely get a moment to rest these days.
say:18:1560302012:1.source_cn: 放心吧，完全没有！我们的旅游业还更兴盛了呢。

say:20:1560302014:1.text: Oh no, sweetie. The Winter Carnival doesn't really come with big public events like the Snowspire Festival did.
say:20:1560302014:1.source_cn: 庆典？啊……亲爱的，恐怕隆冬节期间，你没法体验像冬日祭...

say:21:1560302015:0.text: It's more of a stay-at-home holiday. People usually celebrate privately with their families.
say:21:1560302015:0.source_cn: 毕竟隆冬节是与家人团聚的日子，大家举办的基本都是小型的...

say:24:1560302017:0.text: Exactly! Come on, brighten up. We can make our own little festival. Doesn't need to be fancy. Just something small and nice.
say:24:1560302017:0.source_cn: 没错！打起精神来，我们也可以举办一个小型庆典呀。

say:25:1560302018:1.text: And we've made plenty of friends this year! We can invite them, too.

say:27:1560302020:1.text: I like the idea! I'll take care of the venue. I'll make sure it's warm and comfortable.
say:27:1560302020:1.source_cn: 我喜欢你们的点子！庆典的场地就交给我吧，保准宽敞又暖和。

say:28:1560302021:1.text: I've had many guests lately, so I might not help much with the rest...
say:28:1560302021:1.source_cn: 只是最近客人不少，我恐怕没法帮你们做更多的前期准备了。

say:29:1560302022:1.text: Don't worry about it. We've got this. Chippy loves decorating anyway!
say:29:1560302022:1.source_cn: 没问题！前期准备就交给我们吧，满满最喜欢布置庆典的感觉了！
